title: Italian American Cheese Sandwich
description: A crispy Italian-inspired take on the classic American cheese sandwich. Enjoy as a satisfying snack or light meal.
instructions: 1. Preheat a panini press or grill to medium-high heat.
2. Slice the Italian bread into 1-inch thick slices.
3. Place one slice of bread in the panini press or grill.
4. Top the bread with a slice of American cheese, a few leaves of fresh basil, and a sprinkle of salt and pepper.
5. Place the second slice of bread on top of the filling.
6. Cook for 2-3 minutes, or until the bread is crispy and the cheese is melted.
7. Remove the sandwich from the panini press or grill and let cool for a minute or two.
8. Slice the sandwich in half and serve immediately.
